audit.why: Mel is 42.78% over 367 Emerald+ games. The content layer describes Poppy soaking the entire poke war with her passive shield and tank stats and then out-scaling outright, which is not an even lane.
audit.corrected: HARD at 6.5/10 - moved up, but not to the 8/10 of the true juggernaut lanes, because Poppy has no way to reach Mel in open ground before her ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart disagreed with its own whys at five of seven stages.
audit.why: whys[0] says neither side commits but the chart gave Mel level 1. whys[1] calls level 2 a guaranteed punish but the chart said Skill. whys[2] says Mel out-pokes an immobile Poppy but the chart gave her level 3. whys[3] and whys[5] both say the stage is even while the chart gave both to Poppy. whys[4] calls the level 6 burst "a window, not a finisher", which is not a stage win. Only the last stage was right.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Skill, Mel, Mel, Skill, Skill, Skill, Poppy. This is also the chart the packet holds, so the two sources now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer built the entire matchup around Steadfast Presence - focus field, loading screen, cooldown breakdown and winCon, which claimed "Nothing here works through Steadfast Presence". It also called Poppy "he" throughout. The content layer said "she has no projectile for it to eat".
audit.why: Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes. Mel has no dash - her kit is Radiant Volley, Rebuttal, Solar Snare and Golden Eclipse, none of which is a dash - so Poppy W does nothing to Mel pattern and cannot be the matchup-defining cooldown. The claim that nothing works through it is the reverse of the truth. Meanwhile the two interactions that do decide the lane were absent from both layers: Keeper Verdict is a channel, so Solar Snare cancels it outright and trades an 11s root for a 140s ultimate, and Poppy is untargetable while it channels, so burst dumped into it is thrown away. Iron Ambassador is also a projectile, so Rebuttal reflects the buckler and denies her the shield pickup - the direct opposite of what the content layer told the player.
audit.corrected: Focus moved to Heroic Charge, the ability that actually threatens Mel, with the wall condition stated. Keeper Verdict channel-cancel and untargetability added to dosFull[0] and dontsFull[0]. Iron Ambassador reflect added and the false no-projectile line in the early block replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d said Rebuttal is "gone for twenty seconds", and the cooldown breakdown tracked the wrong ability.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. And the cooldown that gates stepping up is Heroic Charge at 14s, not Steadfast Presence.
audit.corrected: 38s stated, and the breakdown rebuilt around Heroic Charge at 14s plus the 140s Keeper Verdict.

audit.why: The content layer already had the single best piece of hidden knowledge in this matchup - Heroic Charge only stuns when it pins you into terrain, so laning in open ground disarms her all-in. That is stated in spikes[2], wants.you[1] and the early block.
audit.corrected: Left intact and reinforced it in the full layer, which had lost it entirely.
